headline: OpenAI poaches Anthropic product lead, signals competitive intensification
body: Cat Wu, a product leader from Anthropic, has joined OpenAI in a high-profile hire that underscores intensifying competition in the generative AI space. The move matters for healthcare AI because talent shifts between leading labs often precede product capability changes that affect clinical adoption timelines and vendor competitive positioning. OpenAI's recent focus on coding capabilities and infrastructure security (including $1.2M spent addressing Linux kernel vulnerabilities) suggests the company is building toward more robust, production-grade tools for regulated environments like healthcare. Healthcare systems evaluating AI partnerships should track these organizational changes as signals of which vendors are investing in enterprise-grade reliability and compliance infrastructure required for EHR integration and clinical workflows.
